import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/training_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Source1_73_0
# Schema: ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
#          'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']
df_17 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1: Source1_73_1
# Schema: ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness Rank', 'Happiness Score', 'Standard Error',
#          'Economy (GDP per Capita)', 'Family', 'Health (Life Expectancy)', 'Freedom',
#          'Trust (Government Corruption)', 'Generosity', 'Dystopia Residual']
df_15 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename Source 1 columns to match target schema suffix _15
df_15_renamed = df_15.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# The target requires integer for Happiness_Rank_15 and Happiness_Rank_17
df_15_renamed['Happiness_Rank_15'] = df_15_renamed['Happiness_Rank_15'].astype(int)
df_17['Happiness_Rank_17'] = df_17['Happiness_Rank_17'].astype(int)

# The target requires float for all other numerical columns - ensure correct dtypes
float_cols_15 = ['Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
                 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15']
float_cols_17 = ['Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
                 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']

df_15_renamed[float_cols_15] = df_15_renamed[float_cols_15].astype(float)
df_17[float_cols_17] = df_17[float_cols_17].astype(float)

# Join the two dataframes on 'Country'
# Source 1 has 'Region' column, Source 0 does not, so we keep 'Region' from df_15_renamed
df_merged = pd.merge(df_15_renamed, df_17, on='Country', how='inner')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Save the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
